propositions: output_mode blanket-forces PromptedOutput when thinking=True, even though Anthropic now supports native outputConfig with thinking on certain models (Sonnet, Haiku budget 2048).
The historic rationale (tool_choice x thinking as a 400 error) is stale; measured testing (E1) shows native output with thinking is safe and stable today.
A new capability field native_output_with_thinking should gate NativeOutput under thinking, allowing model-specific measured compatibility rather than blanket denial.
Tools combined with thinking and native output suppress tool calling (E1: 2/2 skipped), which is why output_mode is only called in the no-tools single-shot path, not in agentic flows.

With all existing capability records defaulting native_output_with_thinking=False, behavior is unchanged until rows story adds measured cells; this ticket is independently landable with only contrast unit tests.
